By ONE FAMOUS EAGLE SI 101 (2005). Champion, $1,387,453 [G1]. Sire of 784 ROM,
95 stakes winners, $42,195,373, 10 champions, including ONE DASHING EAGLE SI 98
(World Champion, $2,079,065 [G1]), IMPERIAL EAGLE SI 106 (Champion, $1,852,897
[G1]), HOTSTEPPER SI 98 (Champion, $1,336,359 [G1]), BODACIOUS EAGLE SI 104
(World Champion, $1,293,444 [G1]), EAGLES FLY HIGHER SI 114 (Champion, $623,821
[RG1]), HES RELENTLESS SI 107 (Champion, $616,380), MOONIN THE EAGLE SI 111.
1st dam
CARTEL ROSIE SI 106, by Carters Cartel. 9 wins to 4, $180,806, Heritage Place Juvenile S.,
Black Gold 400 Futurity [R], Mystery Derby [R], 3rd Balloon City S., Easy Date H. at Remington
[R], finalist in Black Gold Futurity Champ. [R] [G3]. Sister to Thinkin Man SI 94. Dam of 13 foals
of racing age, all ROM, 10 winners–
POLITICAL ROSE SI 99 (f. by Apollitical Jess), Champion 3-Year-Old Filly. 8 wins in 12
starts to 3, $596,690, All American Oaks [G1], Heritage Place Oaks, 2nd Heritage Place
Futurity [G1].
Im No Lawyer Butt SI 103 (g. by One Famous Eagle). 4 wins to 5, $118,431, 2nd SLM Big
Daddy S. [G2], 3rd Texas Classic Derby [G1].
Mitey Like A Rose SI 93 (f. by FDD Dynasty). 2 wins to 3, $119,017, finalist in Oklahoma
Bred Futurity [R] [G1], Jack Brooks S. [R] [G3].
JM Commander SI 99 (g. by Dulce Sin Tacha). Winner to 3, 2026, $37,542.
Exxquisite SI 94 (f. by Jess Good Candy). 2 wins to 3, 2026, $32,765.
Fightn Side Of Me SI 97 (g. by One Dashing Eagle). Winner to 3, $31,473.
Suprise Secret SI 93 (g. by Hez Our Secret). 3 wins to 4, $30,569.
2nd dam
Long Stemmed Roses SI 92, by First Down Dash. 2 wins to 4, $36,726, 3rd Denim N
Diamonds H. [R], finalist in Governor's Cup Futurity [R] [G1], PCQHRA Breeders Futurity [G1],
Los Alamitos Million Juvenile Inv [R] [G3]. Dam of 20 foals to race, 14 winners, 16 ROM–
CARTEL ROSIE SI 106 (f. by Carters Cartel). Stakes winner, above.
Long Time Favorite SI 93 (Favorite Cartel). 3 wins, $58,818, 2nd Golden State Derby [G2].
Thinkin Man SI 94 (c. by Carters Cartel). 4 wins to 4, $50,860, 3rd Governors S., etc.
Strike A Rose SI 90 (f. by Strawfly Special). Winner at 2, $6,625. Granddam of of
WILDROSES101 SI 122 ($207,272), Heza Majestic Hero SI 96.
3rd dam
Tinys Rose Bud SI 107, by Tiny's Gay. 13 wins in 25 starts to 4, $238,430, 2nd Graham Farms
Futurity, Manor Futurity, finalist in All American Futurity [G1]. Set NTR. Dam of 13 ROM–
STRAWFLYIN BUDS SI 99 (Strawfly Special). 7 wins to 3, $315,974. Southern California Derby
[G1], California Sires' Cup Futurity [R] [G2], 3rd Los Alamitos Million Futurity [G1], Ed Burke Mem.
Futurity [G1], finalist in Los Alamitos Derby [G1], Governor's Cup Derby [R] [G1], PCQHRA
Breeders' Derby [G2]. Sire.
Tinys Effort SI 101 (Special Effort). 5 wins to 4, $61,615, 2nd Graham Farms Maturity, Black Gold
350 Futurity [R], 3rd Black Gold Futurity Champ. [R] [G1], etc. Dam of TINY FIRST EFFORT SI
105 (Champion, $445,393 [G1]), TINY FIRST DOWN SI 105 ($317,881 [G1]), CRASH THRU
TRAFFIC SI 108 ($140,595), Tiny Dash of Cash SI 105 ($211,118 [G1]); granddam of IMA
CHICKIE TWO SI 99 ($346,598 [G2]), EAGLES SPAN SI 96 ($191,378), TERRIFIC ENERGY
SI 101 ($174,393 [G1]), SIZZLING SI 102 ($147,912), CRASHED MY DOOLEY SI 102
($102,882 [R] [G3]), FIRST N FINAL SI 97 ($70,691), FLYING EAGLE 07 SI 106 ($60,662).
ENGAGEMENTS: AQHA Challenge, All American, Rainbow, & Ruidoso Fut.
Eligible for Oklahoma accreditation; embryo transfer.
